title: A novel small molecule NJH-13 induces pyroptosis via the Ca(2+) driven AKT-FOXO1-GSDME signaling pathway in NSCLC by targeting TRPV5.
authors: Dong, Xianxiang; Nie, Jiahui; Huang, Aiying; Chen, Li; Zang, Erkang; Xiang, Zhengrui; Hao, Xiaojiang; Yan, Shengjiao; Ding, Xiao; Zhao, Yuhan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子NJH-13通过TRPV5-Ca2+-AKT-FOXO1通路诱导NSCLC细胞焦亡，虽含ChIP验证FOXO1与GSDME启动子结合及分子对接，但核心是细胞焦亡与抗肿瘤机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合预测，方法上无AI/物理模拟创新。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Pyroptosis represents a mode of programmed necrotic cell death (PCD), mediated by members of gasdermin family (GSDMs), such as GSDME. It is emerging as a promising approach for combating cancer. Notably, GSDME is the key modulator for the switch between apoptosis and pyroptosis in cells. However, GSDME is often downregulated in many malignancies, including lung adenocarcinoma. OBJECTIVE: To identify novel pyroptosis inducers in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and dissect the underlying mechanism. METHODS: Pyroptosis was examined by live cell imaging, PI/Hoechst/Annexin V staining, LDH release assay, ELISA, and western blot assays. DARTS, CETSA, molecular docking was used to identify the target of NJH-13. RNA-seq, qPCR, chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP), dual luciferase assays were used elucidate the mechanism. RESULTS: In this study, NJH-13, an N-containing heterocycle, was screened out and identified to possess the ability to activate GSDME, consequently triggering pyroptosis in NSCLC cells. By using the DARTS strategy, transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 5 (TRPV5) was identified as a potential target of NJH-13. NJH-13 increased intracellular calcium level and triggered oxidative stress, both of which are critical events leading to pyroptosis mediated by GSDME. Mechanistically, NJH-13 enhanced the transcription of GSDME via the protein kinase B (AKT)/forkhead box transcription factor O1 (FOXO1) signaling pathway. ChIP revealed that FOXO1 bound directly to the promoter region of GSDME, thus triggering the GSDME-mediated pyroptosis. Pharmacological and genetic activation of AKT or inhibition of FOXO1 partially rescued NJH-13-induced pyroptotic cell death. Moreover, NJH-13 treatment suppressed tumor growth in vivo. CONCLUSION: Taken together, our results revealed that TRPV5 is a distinctive target for manipulating pyroptosis and provided evidence that NJH-13 functions as a potential anti-cancer agent capable of triggering pyroptosis in NSCLC cells.
abstract_zh: 引言：细胞焦亡（pyroptosis）是一种程序性坏死细胞死亡（PCD）模式，由gasdermin家族（GSDMs）成员（如GSDME）介导，正逐渐成为对抗癌症的一种有前景的策略。值得注意的是，GSDME是细胞凋亡（apoptosis）与细胞焦亡之间转换的关键调节因子。然而，在许多恶性肿瘤（包括肺腺癌）中，GSDME常被下调。目的：在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）中鉴定新型细胞焦亡诱导剂，并解析其潜在机制。方法：通过活细胞成像、PI/Hoechst/Annexin V染色、LDH释放实验、ELISA和western blot实验检测细胞焦亡。使用DARTS、CETSA、分子对接（molecular docking）鉴定NJH-13的靶点。采用RNA-seq、qPCR、染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）、双荧光素酶实验阐明机制。结果：在本研究中，筛选出含氮杂环化合物NJH-13，并鉴定其具有激活GSDME的能力，从而在NSCLC细胞中触发细胞焦亡。通过DARTS策略，瞬时受体电位阳离子通道亚家族V成员5（TRPV5）被鉴定为NJH-13的潜在靶点。NJH-13升高细胞内钙水平并触发氧化应激，这两者均为导致GSDME介导的细胞焦亡的关键事件。机制上，NJH-13通过蛋白激酶B（AKT）/叉头框转录因子O1（FOXO1）信号通路增强GSDME的转录。ChIP实验揭示FOXO1直接结合至GSDME的启动子区域，从而触发GSDME介导的细胞焦亡。药理学和遗传学激活AKT或抑制FOXO1可部分挽救NJH-13诱导的焦亡性细胞死亡。此外，NJH-13处理在体内抑制肿瘤生长。结论：综合来看，我们的结果揭示TRPV5是操纵细胞焦亡的一个独特靶点，并提供证据表明NJH-13作为一种潜在抗癌剂，能够在NSCLC细胞中触发细胞焦亡。
